map.中图法有几大类？: How many basic categories does CLC have?
map.《中国图书馆分类法》设 22 个基本大类，用字母（A-Z，其中 I、O、U、V、: The China Library Classification has 22 basic categories, denoted by letters (A-Z, excluding I, O, U, V, W, X, Y): A Marxism-Leninism, B Philosophy-religion, C Social sciences general, D Politics-law, T Industrial technology (TP Computers) … Z General works. Each major class further divides into secondary and tertiary categories.
map.分类号与索书号有什么区别？: What is the difference between a class number and a call number?
map.分类号（如 TP3）只表示主题归属；索书号 = 分类号 + 著者号/种次号（如: A class number (e.g. TP3) only indicates subject membership; a call number = class number + author number/copy number (e.g. TP3/123), used to uniquely identify one book among the same class, and is the actual basis for shelving and finding books.
